updates.title: Public live-feed architecture added
updates.summary: Created a dedicated public-safe feed repository so the OOT2 website can refresh project status, updates, roadmap, build state, and gallery metadata without exposing the private development repository.

updates.title: Remastered-style graphics direction confirmed
updates.summary: OOT2 remains a new direct sequel to Ocarina of Time. Remastered-style refers only to the visual target, not to remaking the original game.

updates.title: Private and public repositories connected to project plan
updates.summary: The development repository remains private while public website data is emitted through an intentionally sanitized public feed.
